CRM notes (shorthand & call snippets):
- Account: Halcyon Cove (mid-market SaaS, product analytics). Primary goal: reduce token/unit cost for multi-tenant product search + support chat.
- Use: embeddings for semantic search, reranking for topN, chat assistant for in-app help. Must support 99th percentile latency < 120ms for chat read path.
- Security: stern on SSO/SAML + SOC2; CISO asked for KMS integration and audit log retention (3+ years). Data residency: prefer NA region; may require EU residency for certain customers.
- "We can't afford variable costs that spike during product launches" — Head of Infra (quote from 2026-03-05).
- POC takeaways: Hosted API validated functionality quickly, but cost variance and cold-starts in burst windows drove them to consider Dedicated.
- Pricing negotiation specifics being discussed:
  * Commit structure proposed: tiered GPU-hour commit (base commit for steady state + seasonal ramp allowances).
  * Ramp schedule proposed by Redwood: 3-month ramp from 40% -> 100% of committed baseline to avoid heavy upfront spend.
  * Burst credits: included pool of N burst GPU-hours per month (short lived) that can be used without triggering overage charges until threshold.
  * Overage: two-tier overage pricing: soft overage (up to 20% above commit) at discounted rate; hard overage billed at on-demand rate. Finance pushing for blended overage cap.
  * Term: prefer 12 months with quarterly usage true-ups. CFO wants an amortized commit option (monthly accounting-friendly).
  * SLA asks: 99.9% uptime, token latency SLOs, and automatic fallback to hosted API in regional outage. Legal wants fallback spelled out.
- Action items: Aisha to send revised term sheet (v4) with explicit ramp schedule + burst pool math; SE to provide runbook for KMS + VPC peering; finance to produce internal TCO vs self-host spreadsheet.
- Risks: if burst profile > predicted, overage costs could blow estimated ARR; legal may insist on contract language that shifts risk back to vendor unless we accept a higher commit.
- Quick wins: include usage-based Optimize recommendations after 3 months to reduce token consumption and lower effective unit cost.
- Stubs/refs: pricing deck (drive:/deals/halcyon/pricing-deck-v3.pdf), security FAQ (drive:/security/halcyon/security-questions.pdf), demo transcript (ff_20260305_halcyon_demo).
